meta.name: stance_dr10 — stance champion
meta.notes: Pre-deployment-contract stance champion (rise/hold/lower at full DR in sim). Hardware 08-10: its stand-up does NOT transfer — legs do air geometry with no ground force, then a knee stalls (trained before the rate clamp + self-collision limits were in the sim). Implication: keep only as fallback for Lower/holds; never use its RL Stand up — the Experiments-tab tuck is the stand-up.
